title: CAIQ: Tenant boundary validation and sample evidence kit
text:
CAIQ: Tenant boundary validation and sample evidence kit

['From: Anna Schultz <anna@greenfieldhealth.com>\\nDate: 2026-04-07T13:22:00-07:00\\nTo: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>\\nSubject: CAIQ: tenant boundary validation request\\n\\nHi Michael,\\n\\nThanks for the demo earlier. As part of our procurement checklist we\'re putting together a short CAIQ review focused on tenant boundaries and isolation guarantees for PHI-handling workloads. Our security team has requested: a brief diagram of the tenant/network boundary, examples of audit logs showing tenant ID segregation, documentation of retention settings, and an access-control matrix for service accounts.\\n\\nCan you share a compact \\"sample evidence kit\\" we can attach to our CAIQ submission? We\'re aiming to move to legal review by next Thursday (2026-04-15). If there are any items that require redaction (IPs, account ids), flag them and tell us what to expect.\\n\\nThanks —\\nAnna Schultz\\nSr. InfoSec Manager\\nGreenfield Health\\nanna@greenfieldhealth.com\\n\\n--\\nAttachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx (ref)\\n', "From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>\\nDate: 2026-04-07T15:03:00-07:00\\nTo: Anna Schultz <anna@greenfieldhealth.com>\\nCc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>\\nSubject: Re: CAIQ: tenant boundary validation request\\n\\nHi Anna —\\n\\nWe can absolutely provide a focused evidence kit for CAIQ tenant/isolation questions. Attached is a draft bundle that covers the items you listed: tenant-boundary-diagram.png, vpc-peering-logs-2026-03.txt (sanitized), access-control-matrix.csv (service accounts only), and retention-policy-2026.pdf.\\n\\nQuick notes:\\n- The vpc peering logs have account identifiers redacted; we included a redaction key in the readme.\\n- The access-control matrix is scoped to production service accounts; let us know if you need staging/dev artifacts.\\n- We will add a short narrative (1 page) mapping those artifacts to the specific CAIQ questions you flagged — that will help your security reviewers.\\n\\nProposed timeline:\\n- Today: send draft kit (attached).\\n- Tomorrow: internal crosswalk mapping from artifacts -> CAIQ control ids (I'll loop Priyom for the mapping).\\n- By 2026-04-12: final sanitized package for Greenfield legal.\\n\\nIf that timeline works, I’ll create a shared Drive folder and a one-page narrative.\\n\\nBest,\\nMichael Grant\\nHead of Trust & Safety (Partner Security Liaison)\\nRedwood Inference\\nmichael.grant@redwood.com\\n\\n--\\nAttachments: tenant-boundary-diagram.png, vpc-peering-logs-2026-03.txt, access-control-matrix.csv, retention-policy-2026.pdf\\n", "From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>\\nDate: 2026-04-07T16:10:00-07:00\\nTo: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>\\nCc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>\\nSubject: Re: CAIQ: tenant boundary validation request\\n\\nMichael — adding a couple of operational clarifications for the kit.\\n\\n1) Tenant/network boundary diagram: I've attached the latest diagram (tenant-boundary-diagram.png). It shows network segmentation and our runtime isolation layer (multi-tenant routing + per-tenant encryption keys).\\n2) Logs: vpc-peering-logs-2026-03.txt is a curated export (connection records only). I ran a redaction pass for IPs and account numbers; redaction-summary.txt inside the bundle explains the regex used.\\n3) Access control matrix: access-control-matrix.csv includes role mapping and last-modified timestamps. We should include a short export of IAM change history (separate file) — I can generate that by EOD.\\n4) Retention: retention-policy-2026.pdf includes table rows relevant to inference telemetry and KV-cache eviction policies.\\n\\nKimberly, can you confirm whether we should include a statement about the KMS key rotation cadence? That typically helps CAIQ auditors.\\n\\nNaomi\\nSecurity Operations\\nRedwood Inference\\n\\nOn Apr 7, 2026, at 15:03, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com> wrote:\\n> Hi Anna —\\n>\\n> We can absolutely provide a focused evidence kit for CAIQ tenant/isolation questions...\\n", 'From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>\\nDate: 2026-04-08T08:45:00-07:00\\nTo: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>\\nCc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Anna Schultz <anna@greenfieldhealth.com>\\nSubject: Re: CAIQ: tenant boundary validation request\\n\\nThanks — I\'ve started the CAIQ crosswalk and will bind these artifacts to the specific control ids (CID: CCM-IA-1, CCM-SI-4, CCM-DI-2, etc.) in a short spreadsheet.\\n\\nNotes for the package:\\n- I\'ll produce a \\"crosswalk.csv\\" that lists artifact file -> CAIQ question id -> short verifier note.\\n- For auditability, I\'ll add fingerprints/hashes for each file we ship.\\n- Suggest we include a short acceptance checklist for the customer to sign-off on receipt of sanitized artifacts.\\n\\nAnna — timeline check: Michael proposed a delivery by 2026-04-12 for the final package. Can you confirm if legal needs anything earlier?\\n\\nPriyom\\nSecurity Assurance\\nRedwood Inference\\n\\nOn Apr 7, 2026, at 16:10, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com> wrote:\\n> Michael — adding a couple of operational clarifications for the kit...\\n', "From: Anna Schultz <anna@greenfieldhealth.com>\\nDate: 2026-04-08T10:05:00-07:00\\nTo: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>\\nCc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodhealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, procurement@greenfieldhealth.com\\nSubject: Re: CAIQ: tenant boundary validation request\\n\\nThanks, team — this is exactly what we needed.\\n\\nA couple of small asks from legal/security: please include the KMS key rotation cadence statement (Kimberly), and the hash fingerprints for each file (Priyom). If you can get the final sanitized package by 2026-04-12 that works for our legal timeline — earlier is welcome.\\n\\nOne small preference: can the crosswalk map the artifacts to the CAIQ question numbers and also to the corresponding SOC 2 CC if available? That helps our reviewers who are triaging multiple frameworks.\\n\\nAppreciate it — looking forward to the folder link.\\n\\nAnna\\nSr. InfoSec Manager\\nGreenfield Health\\n\\nOn Apr 8, 2026, at 08:45, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com> wrote:\\n> Thanks — I've started the CAIQ crosswalk and will bind these artifacts to the specific control ids...\\n"]
